review:
Fury of Odin Megaways puts the Norse pantheon on a six-reel Megaways grid with up to 117,649 ways. Odin, Thor and Freya are among the symbols, and wins trigger tumbles so new symbols can drop in. Wilds substitute for everything except scatters.

The Fury icon turns every position below it wild, effectively creating a partial or full wild reel, and mystery symbols reveal matches. Four or more scatters trigger free spins in which each win raises a multiplier by 1x, while the Fury and mystery features stay active. Pragmatic Play gives the maximum win as 15,000x. Note the RTP is 95.97%, under 96%, so the game is slightly more expensive to play over time than many others here.
